newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end at record high on euphoric buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end at record high on euphoric buying.

text.p: Dhaka stocks scaled a record peak in a bull run sparked by euphoric buying by retail investors who were still extremely confident about the country's economy, brokers said.

The benchmark price index of Dhaka Stock Exchange rose 6.07 percent or 114.88 points to 2,005.24 on record volume of 298.9 million taka. Of the 112 issues traded, 81 closed up, 27 down and four unchanged. It was the second straight sharp rise after Saturday's 5.82 percent gain.
Bangladesh Tobacco gained 56.35 taka to 341.69, Apex Foods rose 640.25 to 8.953.51 and BD Lamps advanced 194.13 to 7,447.

"This is certainly a demonstration of overconfidence in the future of the economy. Prices are reaching levels having little or no relation to fundamentals of the companies. This is something disturbing," said one broker.

Brokers said the market immediately needed a supply of fresh scrip to meet the thirst of investors. "The privatization program (of the government) must be geared up," said an analyst with a leading brokerage firm.
